# Daily Dose of Galaxy

> Daily Dose of Galaxy is the spiritual practice of Sharon Aurelio: tarot, Reiki, intuitive shamanic readings and Pixán, a signature session that turns what emerges from the soul into language, direction and form. Intuition with structure; strategy with soul. Sessions are remote (phone or WhatsApp), in Spanish or English. Based in Chicago; rooted in Mexico.

Sharon Aurelio is a shamanic empath, a certified Reiki practitioner and the granddaughter of a nahualli. She is also an architect by training and a brand and market strategist with 18+ years of experience with global firms (see Sharon Aurelio Studio: https://sharonaureliostudio.com/). Daily Dose of Galaxy is where those two sides meet.

## Offerings

- Tarot Reading (Lectura de Tarot): 30 minutes, $44 USD. Book online: https://calendar.app.google/UWGa9F4P9bLr4fob9
- Tarot Parties (Tardes de Tarot): 90 minutes for up to 4 people, $222 USD. Book online: https://calendar.app.google/4gYeQWeHTzMypKo57
- Intuitive Shamanic Reading (Lectura Chamánica Intuitiva): by invitation only; ritual preparation, water scrying, a meditation with the four elements and an hour together. Inquire by email.
- Reiki Healing (Sanación con Reiki): remote sessions, by invitation only. Inquire by email.
- Pixán: signature strategy + soul session. Foundation $333 (90 min + deliverable), Pixán Complete $555 (adds a 30-min follow-up within 2 weeks), Extended $888 (2 hours, full deliverable, 30 days of email support; for founders and teams).

Payment is made via PayPal or Zelle after booking. Readings and healing sessions are for spiritual guidance only and do not replace medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.
